text: Morning digest, two items. (1) San Antonio update: a software outage on the line. We're dark from next Friday through Monday Mar 22; the line restarts the following working day. (2) Quick heads up from Quanta: the infotainment chip run for Princeton can't make it next Monday. Carrier says next Friday now (severe weather on the route).

summary: E-01 is Plant outage, Supplier delay. 29 production orders move (26 rescheduled, 3 transferred). 46 dealer notice(s) and 46 loaner assignment(s).
reasoning: Walked Plant P_TX → production orders scheduled 2027-03-12 through 2027-03-22 inclusive. 21 orders cannot build during the outage. The line restarts 2027-03-23. Rule 2 and rule 3. Placed 18 at the same plant and transferred 3. Walked SH-0190 → CHIP-IVI → NOVA, PIONEER, SUMMIT, TERRA, VOYAGER (bill of materials) → production orders at P_IN from 2027-03-15 up to 2027-03-19. 8 orders need the delayed part. Rule 1 and rule 3. Placed 8 at the same plant and transferred 0. Rule 4: 46 dealer notice(s), one each, listing only affected customer orders. Rule 5: 46 loaner(s) for Platinum and Gold in priority order; 22 entitled order(s) left without a car because the pool ran out. Standard customers are on the dealer notice only. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.

handoffs.did: Split the message into 2 incident(s) and dispatched specialists.
